## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue.

## Validation

List exact commands/results and the macOS/toolchain used. Include native screenshots
for UI changes, with synthetic PDFs and sample notes. State any unverified paths.

## Review points

Explain changes to persistence, book identity, original files, OCR acceptance, or
MCP capabilities when applicable. Describe rollback or migration considerations.

- [ ] Relevant tests/checks passed, or failures are explained above.
- [ ] Docs and command examples match the final behavior.
- [ ] The diff contains no private PDFs, notes, credentials, or runtime artifacts.
